name: 日付と料理を組み合わせる献立カード
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE Japanese Lighthouse component LH19-0002: compact single-day meal plan card. Landscape composition on pure white #FFFFFF, close framing with modest margins. Do not produce a full screen or multiple days.
Input 1 ORIGINAL Crouton screen is highest authority for precise plus glyph, three horizontal dots, icon proportions, optical weight, alignment, spacing and anatomy. Use ONLY Monday Jun8 card region, not other days/navigation. Input2 actual original salmon-cake thumbnail is protected photo, preserve its exact crop, fish/vegetable/plate arrangement and original colors. Input3 saved Japanese mock is SECONDARY content guide, not icon authority. Input4 approved bus style guides white rounded surfaces and restrained elevation only.
Exact Japanese content: header 「月曜日」 bold, date 「6月8日」 regular beside it; header trailing PLUS addition control and horizontal ellipsis other-actions control, source geometry. Below one row: small rounded-square original food photo and 「祖母のサーモンケーキ」. No invented ingredients, extra rows, badges or navigation.
Refine the original two-level card into white rounded card with subtle neutral border and soft downward shadow. Keep compact original grouping and calm hierarchy. Header white, optional very fine divider. Plus is the primary action: small forest-green gradient circular button #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with white crisp plus, gentle edge light. Ellipsis remains slate #526173 on white. All other supporting details slate. Original Monday is unselected with neutral header; don't borrow Friday's blue selection outline. Photograph retains natural accents; no decorative additional accent required.
Typography locked Meiryo, heading Bold20/28 only where established, body Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0 at logical phone scale. Preserve compact weekday role from mock rather than enlarge header excessively. Readable Japanese without clipping. No broad mint, rainbow icons, gloss, giant whitespace or extra captions.
reviewNotes: 原本優先で追加の＋と三点の形・配列を確認。月曜日／6月8日／祖母のサーモンケーキ、料理サムネイルの内容・配置と全操作を実見。原本の対象行は未選択のため金曜の青選択は導入せず、主要追加を森林色、三点をスレートに整理。白面・細い境界・柔らかい影・日本語の欠けなしを確認。画素比較／フォント数値一致・所有者承認・編集可能性・アプリ動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
